title: Parse `Atom Type Labels` in `read_lammps_data` and `write_lammps_data`
body:
closes #1840

This MR allows parsing `Atom Type Labels` instead of numerical types in `read_lammps_data`.
Also, the `atom_type_labels: bool` option is added to `write_lammps_data` so that we can input element names in a LAMMPS data file.
Minor stylistic adjustments in `write_lammps_data` are also done to better in line with the LAMMPS [`write data`](https://docs.lammps.org/write_data.html) command.

~~This MR is on top of !3915; until that MR is merged, I mark the present one as draft.~~
